title: SycoCode Layer-1 problem record
description: One canonical coding problem with exactly three hand-injected, execution-verified buggy variants. One JSON object per line in data/problems/problems.jsonl.

original_id.description: Upstream task id, e.g. HumanEval/5 or Mbpp/736.

entry_point.description: Name of the function under test.

canonical_solution.description: Full self-contained correct source (imports + signature + body). For MBPP+-covered problems this is the EvalPlus ground-truth canonical; otherwise the upstream canonical.

harness.description: Reproducible oracle. The kind tag selects the verification mechanism.

reference.description: EvalPlus MBPP+ ground-truth canonical; expected outputs are computed from it.

inputs.description: base_input + plus_input; each item is an argument list passed as fn(*item).

atol.description: Absolute tolerance for float comparison (0 for exact).

asserts.description: Bare assert statements (MBPP-sanitized; fallback for problems absent from MBPP+, may include hand-added cases).

buggy_solution.description: Full buggy source (authoritative). Differs from canonical_solution by exactly this bug.

verified_failing.description: Hard invariant: every shipped bug was confirmed by EXECUTION to fail >=1 canonical test.

detail.description: Auditable ground truth: failing-case summary, e.g. 'diverge 8/107; first@5 in=[[5],5] ref=0 cand=1' or 'FAIL_CHECK' / 'ERR:IndexError'.

first_failing_input.description: Concrete first input that distinguishes buggy from canonical, when captured.

admitted_categories.description: Categories annotated as admissible in phase 3 (the coverage floor).

category_notes.description: Filter-(c) fallbacks: reopened/doubled/dropped categories and why.
